seo.title: Medline Industries, LP Breathing Circuits Recalled Over Burn
seo.description: Medline Industries, LP is recalling Breathing Circuits over a burn hazard. Distribution: worldwide distribution.

paragraphs: Medline Industries, LP is recalling Breathing Circuits because of a burn hazard, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. The recall was initiated on July 13, 2026.

body.heading: What is being recalled
paragraphs: Medline breathing circuits labeled as: 1) HUDSON RCI, CIRCUIT, HTD, DL, NEONATE, 48, Medline Product Number/SKU HUD78007 (Teleflex Product Number/SKU 780-07); 2) HUDSON RCI, DBM-CIRCUIT,VENT,NEONAT

body.heading: Why it is being recalled
paragraphs: Neonatal and infant heated wire breathing circuits may experience sporadic failure. The heated wire connector (pigtail) at the humidifier may exhibit discoloration, melting, smoke, burning odor, or other signs of localized thermal damage. Device failure may predispose infant to bronchospasm, inspissated secretions, and airway obstruction, as well as inadvertent positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP), circuit obstruction, or accidental lavage of pooled fluid into the airway, elevated oxygen consumption, and worsening respiratory distress.

body.heading: Where it was sold or distributed
paragraphs: Worldwide distribution - US Nationwide and the country of Panama.

body.heading: What consumers should do
paragraphs: Consumers can review the FDA recall record for product and distribution details.

body.heading: Source
paragraphs: This article was produced from an official FDA recall record initiated on July 13, 2026. U.S. Food and Drug Administration is the original source of this recall notice.
